name: Bonsly
flavorText: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
description: Bonsly is the Bonsai Pokémon, a Rock-type first discovered in the Sinnoh region. It stands 1'08" (0.5 m) tall and weighs 33.1 lbs (15.0 kg). Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health. This Pokémon lives in dry, rocky areas. As its green spheres dry out, their dull luster increases.
